title: Hook catalog for Olden Era mods (families taken from Golden Era work)
proof: source/static teaching index. Obfuscated method names drift after hotfixes. Copy the family and the ownership rule, then re-pin live names in your own GameSymbols file. Golden Era class names below are examples from one plugin, not a public API.
principles: Prefer a native Core row over a Harmony patch.
Put live generated names in one registry. Do not scatter them through feature code.
One problem has one owner. Do not add a second damage, occupancy, or town-click path.
Fail closed. A missing symbol must skip the feature or leave native behavior alone.
After types match, key Il2Cpp objects by native pointer, not managed GetHashCode.

families.title: Symbol registry
families.when: Any live IL2CPP name is needed.
families.symbolsClass: your GameSymbols-style registry (Golden Era nested this as GameSymbols)

hooks.name: Centralize pins
hooks.owner: one symbol registry file in your plugin
hooks.do: Add a MethodSymbol or type-hint list here, then read it from the hook.
hooks.doNot: Hardcode RVAs or dump-era names in feature files. Dump is not live.

families.title: Battle unit construction
families.when: You need the live battle Unit, hex, or side at spawn/init.

hooks.name: Unit.Init
hooks.do: On one Olden Era patch used while making Golden Era, argument 2 was a battle-side wrapper (live type then: ObjectPublicPrcgObPrcgInTrPrcgInUnique). Re-pin on your GameAssembly. Bridge to TransferSide before a TransferSide-keyed lookup.
hooks.doNot: Treat the wrapper as TransferSide. Do not throw fail-closed from optional pilots on BattleLogic.Init; that method also runs during adventure-map Loader.

families.title: Selected-unit action bar
families.when: Custom Focus abilities must appear, highlight, and accept number keys.

hooks.name: Action bar bind / overlay
hooks.do: Bind clicks and number keys from the current unit SID. Overlay custom icons without writing into native pics images that later vanilla binds reuse.
hooks.doNot: Add a standalone Input.GetKeyDown poll as a second hotkey owner.

families.title: Hero ability UI
families.when: Custom hero-bar icons or extra buttons must appear.

hooks.name: Hero-bar icon bind
hooks.owner: your generated-Core icon cache + hero-bar bind
hooks.do: Load icon keys from packed Core hero_ability rows. Fail closed if the cache loads zero custom rows.
hooks.doNot: Broad child-image scans or WIP-sprite fallbacks as the product path.

families.title: Focus / energy economy
families.when: A law or ability must grant, spend, or display Focus.

hooks.name: Energy manager grant
hooks.do: Use the energy manager members you pinned. Ability cost in Core is energyLevel.
hooks.doNot: Invent a second Focus counter. Combat Focus pips are native children on the ability view (on one pin: BhAbilityViewBase.energyContainer). Do not cover them with an overlay sprite.

families.title: Committed damage
families.when: A design cannot be a native unitStat / outDmgMods law row.

hooks.name: Apply damage prefix
hooks.do: One damage owner. Pair DamageApplied postfix with a typed prefix that sets __state. Unwrap damage __0; it is not a ready Unit.
hooks.doNot: Add a stale method name as a silent fallback. Do not share ownership with a Direct State damage adapter.

families.title: Buff add and got-buff dispatch
families.when: You add a custom buff and need the native got-buff event.

hooks.name: BuffEventDispatch
hooks.owner: the Method_N you pin by field offset, not by DiffableCs index
hooks.do: Pin via field offset to short name to Method_N. Sender is the ability/native source, never the hub as both this and arg0.
hooks.doNot: Treat DiffableCs declaration index 39 as Method_39. That raise is ChangeAbility and live-negatives with a cast exception. One Golden Era pin used Method_35 / cfin for got-buff; re-pin.

families.title: Unit battle / map / preview visuals
families.when: A custom unit must replace a donor visual after native construction.
families.symbolsClass: your battle / preview / map visual pins

hooks.name: Release battle visual
hooks.do: On skinned_mesh, use a cache-only battle presentation lookup during combat Init.
hooks.doNot: ResManager-load the donor presentation template on that path (it can freeze combat). Do not copy skinned-only packs over billboard bundles.

hooks.name: Preview factory
hooks.do: Preview catalog ids can be shorter than the gameplay SID. Copy the live preview id. Golden Era dungeon example: preview used trogl, not troglodyte.
hooks.doNot: Stamp Sprites/Default overlay materials onto owned skinned meshes.

hooks.name: Adventure-map billboard
hooks.do: Sanitize Hex/Lit. Skip billboard finish for skinned instances and play Idle instead.
hooks.doNot: Use a plain UI sprite material on a map quad.

families.title: Owned city world
families.when: A custom faction needs a playable town screen.

hooks.name: City scene replace
hooks.do: LoadScene donor, move into owned scene, keep native BhBuilding clicks. cityFactory is a Golden Era scene-pattern name, not “reuse vanilla Factory town.”
hooks.doNot: Use Route A posters, click relays, or alias this town onto another live faction city as the product path.

hooks.name: Hall construction open
hooks.do: Close only panels that are visually open (Canvas.enabled + CanvasGroup).
hooks.doNot: Call escape/hide because a panel is activeInHierarchy. Hierarchy-active is not user-visible.

families.title: Town and dwelling map billboards
families.when: Adventure-map towns or external dwellings need custom art or hire payloads.

hooks.name: Town map billboard
hooks.do: Resolve visuals per instance. Keep donor ObjectConfig.id stable.
hooks.doNot: Rewrite shared donor ids to custom ids while direct custom rows also exist (duplicate-key map load).

hooks.name: Dwelling hire
hooks.do: Require exact hire payload or saved original SID for donor-to-custom reverse mapping.
hooks.doNot: Map donor barracks to a custom dwelling because 'a custom city was seen'.

families.title: Portraits and UI icons
families.when: Custom keys are absent from the serialized sprite registry.

hooks.name: Custom UI icon resolver
hooks.do: Supply Sprite results for known custom key prefixes. Patch the owning component.
hooks.doNot: Broad Image.sprite postfix or descendant Image scans. Clear overrideSprite on pooled rows. Do not open the resolver to arbitrary strings.

families.title: Custom law runtime (gated)
families.when: A law cannot be expressed as a native Core bonus primitive.

hooks.name: Packet gate
hooks.owner: your explicit proof gate for hook-required laws
hooks.do: Keep hook-required laws behind packet proofs. Native-data replacements are the default product.
hooks.doNot: Enable speculative mutators because a CSV mentions them.

families.title: Direct State transactions
families.when: You need a journaled native store write with rollback, and no Core donor verb exists.

hooks.name: Traced store adapter
hooks.do: Trace the store transaction. Still prove presentation separately.
hooks.doNot: Treat CapLog store agreement as combat done. Do not dual-write occupancy.

families.title: Custom biome and terrain
families.when: The faction nativeBiome is not a vanilla biome string the terrain dictionaries already know.

hooks.name: Terrain material registration
hooks.do: Coordinate tiles, waters, generator config, arena views, obstruction models, and sounds. Refresh materials after render textures exist.
hooks.doNot: Change only DB/biomes_info.json. Do not rebuild render textures from a map-build prefix before width is nonzero. Do not guess a HoMM3 terrain name as the biome string.

families.title: Session and menu load
families.when: Custom factions must appear in new-game / custom-game lists.

hooks.name: Custom game hub
hooks.do: Serialized faction-selector assets may not know custom ids. Intercept the selector, or add the faction to the serialized list through a proven path. On one Golden Era pin the selector type was SoFractions; re-pin.
hooks.doNot: Assume a Core fractions JSON row alone makes the faction pickable.

families.title: Faction extra hero actions
families.when: Warcry, Gating, Avenger, Arcane Battery, Elite Strategem, and similar extra buttons.
families.symbolsClass: per-family extra-action pins in your registry

hooks.name: Additive grants
hooks.owner: heroBattleAbility rows plus the matching UI/runtime hook
hooks.do: Grant an extra ability SID. Keep commander attack unless replacement is explicit. Elite Strategem must key pending mode by casting DataHero.id.
hooks.doNot: Use a process-global Strategem mode. Do not overwrite skill_warrior_ability for one shout.
